name: Breezy Donkey 2
author: BurgiSimon
description: Neon rounded green toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #ff3636 to #00c763, transform becomes translateX(2.5em), starts the slideRight animation (bouncing). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px #00c763.
